jobs.title: LIBRE Regional Field Manager, PA - Harrisburg
jobs.description_text: Rooted in the Hispanic community, The LIBRE Initiative brings people together to advance public policy solutions that create the freedom and opportunity that people need to chase their American Dream. LIBRE empowers our communities by fixing our broken immigration system, encouraging affordable and flexible healthcare options, building an individualized education system, and promoting a robust economy that helps everyone succeed. The LIBRE Initiative is a part of Americans for Prosperity and the Stand Together philanthropic community. As a Regional Field Manager (internally called a Grassroots Engagement Director), you’ll recruit and mobilize grassroots leaders across the Harrisburg Tri-County area in Pennsylvania and inspire them to take action and drive policy reforms that open opportunities for all. This is a hands-on community organizing role for someone who loves meeting people and building movements. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $50,000–$65,000 per year. This role may also be eligible for additional bonus compensation designed to align total compensation with an employee’s overall contribution to the organization.

As part of our work, we help leaders refine their messaging and storytelling and, when needed, apply it to specific engagements (keynote remarks, podcast interviews, all-staff retreats) where they’ll share that message. As a Program Manager, you’ll own the operational management and day-to-day execution of programming connected to this leader coaching program. A successful Program Manager will maintain lead smooth programming, proactively identify opportunitiesfor improvement, and drive execution that elevates Stand Together Foundations’ non-profit leader support. This role may also be eligible for additional bonus compensation designed to align total compensation with an employee’s overall contribution to the organization.

jobs.title: Senior Strategist
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Strategist on Stand Together’s Strategic Analysis team, you will be a trusted advisor to our issue teams on their hardest questions. Our team builds the research, insights, and standards behind our Priority Initiatives. These are the teams that lead our work on issues like Unleashing Economic Growth and Mobility and Bridging Divides. You will work embedded with one of them, from early strategy to finished materials. You will use research, our internal knowledge, and experts across the organization to build points of view and strategies. Then you will write them up so our staff and stakeholders can act on them. You will bring rigor to the issue leader’s hardest questions. The issue leader stays accountable for the strategy. This role fits a senior individual contributor who thinks like an advisor. You stay calm in ambiguity. You can turn a lot of data and information into one clear point of view. And you like helping other teams turn strategy into impact.

jobs.title: Lead Mil-Ka Senior System Engineering Specialist
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Within the System Engineering team, lead the technical coordination needed to adapt Lightspeed’s low Earth orbit constellation and associated ground infrastructure for military Ka-band communications supporting the Enhanced Satellite Communications Project - Polar (ESCP-P) and other defence customers. This is a senior individual-contributor role in which you will lead technical work across all Lightspeed teams without managing staff. You will build on established designs, analyses, and test plans, focusing additional analysis where decisions require it. ESCP-P is intended to meet Government of Canada requirements by providing the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) with secure, resilient, high-speed communications for operations at home and abroad, particularly in Arctic and other high-latitude regions. The project supports Canada’s Arctic sovereignty and continental defence, including interoperability with the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) and North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD).

jobs.description_text: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. jobs.title: Customer Value & Growth Program Manager
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Customer Value & Growth Program Manager to own and drive the company-wide program that ensures our customers realize the value of their investment with Achievers and incrementally grow their spend with us as a result. Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Marketplace, Enablement, Revenue Operations and Finance each own a piece of this today. You will sit at the centre, pulling those pieces into one integrated strategy, guiding and collaborating with each team as they build their part, and making sure everything we do aligns to a consistent vision. You are accountable for making sure the right plans exist, that they connect, and that the functions who deliver them are set up to execute. Your impact comes from how well you align, equip and drive the people closest to our customers. The role goes beyond program management. We are looking for someone who brings a commercial point of view, challenges the plans on the table, contributes to the thinking, and acts as a genuine partner to every function involved.

jobs.title: Finance Manager, Marketplace ⭐
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a highly motivated and analytical SFA/Manager to take full ownership of our global e-commerce Marketplace P&L, one of Achievers' most important revenue streams. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Business Intelligence, Customer Success, Merchandising, and Product, translating Marketplace activity into financial insight, strategic forecasting, and operational action. You won't just report the numbers - you'll explain what happened, forecast what comes next, and actively shape the strategy and direction to help support growth. From building predictive models and share-of-wallet analyses to partnering with Customer Success on NRR strategy and existing customer ARR forecasting, this is a role for someone who wants to make a measurable impact across the business. If you bring experience from e-commerce, retail, or a rewards/marketplace environment, that's a significant advantage, you'll hit the ground running with an intuitive understanding of redemption and e-commerce dynamics, catalogue economics, and customer purchasing behavior that are central to this role.

jobs.description_text: The Marketplace is the rewards shopping experience within the Achievers platform. Its performance is shaped by a connected set of drivers, including member access, traffic, utilization, conversion, redemption, catalogue relevance, vendor performance, fulfilment reliability and the economics of each transaction. As Manager, Marketplace Performance Intelligence, you will give Marketplace one clear view of performance and turn intelligence into coordinated action. You will lead Marketplace operational analytics and identify opportunities to improve performance and scalability, own the analytics roadmap and recurring performance routines, and shape executive narratives/decisions. You will work in close partnership with the Finance Manager, Marketplace through a formal dotted-line relationship, connecting FP&A’s official financial outlook and governance with deeper customer, member and operational evidence. This role is also expected to structure and execute complex analyses that are cross-functional, commercially material, ambiguous or executive-facing. Success requires strong analytical judgement, commercial curiosity and executive communication. jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer Position for Xsolla's Smart Wallet in Web3
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who has tested real on-chain products — the contracts and the transactions, not only the web app in front of them. You will own quality for Xsolla's smart wallet on Xsolla ZK, our Ethereum-compatible ZK rollup: the wallet players use to hold, receive and send tokens and in-game items, signing in with the account they already have. The work runs on both sides of the chain. On the backend, you will confirm that a wallet address pre-computed from a salt is the address that actually gets deployed. On the frontend, you will follow a signed operation from the client's RPC call through the bundler to finality, and prove it landed, failed or reverted the way it should. You will fork the chain to test against real state, deploy and call contracts from the command line, and turn what you learn into automated suites. You will work in a small, senior engineering team alongside an external wallet-infrastructure partner. You can tell a defect in our code from one in a partner SDK or in the chain itself — and you bring the evidence to show which. AI coding tools are part of how you work every day, and you set them up so the rest of the team gets the same leverage.

jobs.description_text: About Xsolla Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. About the Role We're looking for a Staff Engineer to own the smart wallet and account abstraction layer of Xsolla's Web3 platform. This is an individual contributor role with outsized technical scope: you'll be the technical anchor for how millions of players get an on-chain account they never have to think about — setting direction, making hard architectural calls, and raising the bar across the org. Concretely, you'll own the account model behind Xsolla ZK, our zkSync-based L2, and the wallet that sits inside Xsolla App. Every player who signs in with Xsolla ID receives a deterministic, non-custodial smart account — derived from their identity claim, identical on every device, with private keys that never leave the client. That account is not a separate "wallet" screen: it is the player's inventory, and it backs minting, gifting, trading on our Bazaar marketplace, Merkle-based reward airdrops, gas sponsorship, and an in-app dApp browser that exposes the same signer to third-party applications through an EIP-1193 provider. You'll own the primitives underneath all of it: the ERC-4337 user operation lifecycle, EIP-7702 delegation, session keys and origin-bound Smart Sessions, paymaster and gas abstraction strategy, and the custody and recovery roadmap — including the move from raw key export to MPC custody. They will manage and support their direct reports (client services team) in order to develop and maintain a high performing team. The Director will work in partnership with the Security Leaders and Sales teams to ensure Practice deliverables to customers are complete, consistent, high quality, on time and deliver valued outcomes. A central part of the role is making day-to-day executive work easier by knowing what is needed before it is requested, removing friction, and creating a smooth, well-organized experience around the work. The ideal candidate brings exceptional judgment, discretion, organization, and communication skills. They are comfortable operating with limited direction, quickly distinguish what is urgent from what is important, and represent executive leadership and AHEAD with professionalism and polish in every interaction.

The SSE is also considered an organizational thought leader for their specialty area.

jobs.title: GPU Engineer
jobs.description_text: About Kog At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents. Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act. Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs. We've developed several technologies to make this possible: Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs. KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency. Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading. Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach. Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution. Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released. Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today. These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark perfo

jobs.title: DevOps Engineering Intern
jobs.description_text: About the role We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineering intern to join our Platform team (DevOps, Data and Staff Engineers), which runs the infrastructure behind our SaaS platform. As the platform grows, so do our internal operational requests. Your mission will be to find out how far AI agents can take this RUN work off our plate, without giving up control. Your main mission will be to: Build an AI agent that turns internal infrastructure requests (provisioning a new service, managing AWS resources and access, environment variables or app configuration, Kubernetes or ArgoCD resources) into ready-to-review GitHub Pull Requests: Understand. The agent parses the request and picks the matching runbook. Generate. It produces the Terraform, Kubernetes or ArgoCD changes in our IaC repositories. Validate. It runs automated checks: tests, linting, and security and misconfiguration scans. Propose. It opens a traceable Pull Request for human review and approval. Design the guardrails that make this safe: least-privilege access, approval steps, and predictable, repeatable runs. The AI never changes production on its own, and engineers stay in control of every change, Deliver a working proof of concept on real internal requests, built so it can grow into a production-ready tool. The AI never changes production on its own. Engineers stay in control, and every change is reviewed, tested and traceable. Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
jobs.description_text: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on. What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.
